data.body: **[P2] Validate every serialized wire member.** Deriving serialization checks from `CONSTRAINED_MEMBERS` omits `Payload`, `Error.*`, `ContextOptions.ReplayChildren`, option containers, and stack-trace elements. For example, throwing `{ name: "X", message: 1 }` produces a numeric `ErrorMessage` that is checkpointed locally, while Lambda rejects that string member with `SerializationException`, changing retry and failure behavior. Build body-order validation from the complete wire schema and add an integration test for non-string thrown-object fields.
